threads.hunk:
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+Deprecate get_telemetry_handler, construct a TelemetryHandler with instrumentation_scope_name instead

threads.body: `TelemetryHandler.__init__` currently coerces a missing `instrumentation_scope_version` to an empty string (`""`) and also allows passing a version without a scope name (producing a util scope name with a potentially unrelated version). This can lead to spans/metrics/logs reporting a surprising scope version (`""`) or a mismatched name/version pair. Prefer passing `None` through when the version is unknown, and if the scope name is omitted, always default both name and version to the util module for backwards compatibility.
